name: 承認の詳細サイドパネル
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Render ONE complete Japanese Lighthouse approval-detail side panel LH09-0041, portrait666x854 logical pixels, tightly filling the frame. ORIGINAL images1–2 control hierarchy, geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weights, alignment, spacing, real icons and complete visible state. Mock3 supplies Japanese copy only: its rough substitute symbols and omissions are WRONG. No surrounding app, left table, device shell or watermark.
Use pure white #FFFFFF canvas and all ordinary surfaces including notice/comments/footer, fine neutral borders, small5px corners and restrained shadow. No gray/mint broad panels. Official primary/selected gradient135deg #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E. Neutral utilities #526173. Semantic amber change/red reject only where meaningful.
Typography: Meiryo, zero tracking. Main title Bold20/28 ONLY. All other body/control text Regular14/24, metadata/property labels Regular12/16. Never all-bold.
Preserve original compact structure/vertical placement:
TOP y0–54: left three compact26px buttons. White check +「承認」on green gradient. Original amber curved request-change return glyph +「変更を依頼」on white bordered button. Red X +「却下」white border. To right EXACT seven original small utility glyphs: outlined thumbs-up, paperclip, connected-node relationship, diagonal chain link, opposing diagonal expand arrows, horizontal ellipsis, right-arrow ending at vertical bar. Do not use mock heart/club/bent-line/repeated arrows.
NOTICE y54–104: small ORIGINAL filled LOCK with arch shackle, message「共同作業者と親の作業を閲覧できる人に表示されます。」with natural wrapping, right unboxed green action「公開する」. White surface/fine divider.
HEADER x22: metadata「礼拝の準備」near y120; parent breadcrumb「資料を準備する」+original TINY thin right chevron near y146; main heading「資料の確認」near y184.
PROPERTIES: labels x22, values x154. At y230「担当者」, ORIGINAL dark photo avatar appearance +「山田 花子」+tiny remove X, then「最近割り当て」with thin down chevron. At y268「期日」, original calendar INSIDE dashed circle +「期日なし」. At y306「依存関係」,「依存関係を追加」. At y344 green text link「継承した項目を表示」. No mint avatars or square substitute calendar.
TIME FIELDS y370–442: left「項目」, right x144 white bordered2-row table about476px wide,40/60 column ratio, fine dividers. Row1 original tiny thin CLOCK +「予定工数」, right「予定工数を追加」. Row2 original tiny STOPWATCH with exact source top details +「実績工数」, right「実績を追加」then original thin CIRCLE enclosing HOLLOW PLAY TRIANGLE +「計測を開始」. Distinguish clock/stopwatch; no invented symmetric stopwatch knobs or solid play triangle.
DESCRIPTION: x22 label「説明」near y480; body「内部で確認し、修正を反映する」near y510. Lower-left compact original plus button near y608「子作業を追加」, green gradient/white original thin plus/text,28px high.
DISCUSSION y652 onward: active「コメント」with thin brand gradient underline, inactive「すべての活動」; right ORIGINAL two opposing vertical sort arrows +「古い順」. Fine divider. Original small dark photo avatar x22 and empty white textarea x58,y724 about586x76px, fine border5px corners; placeholder「コメントを追加」. No submitted comment or send button.
FOOTER near y830:「共同作業者」then ORIGINAL dark photo avatar, white thin-border initial avatar「佐」, original dashed-circle person, standalone small PLUS. Right ORIGINAL filled BELL +「承認から退出」. No club symbol.
ALL Japanese words must be accurate and visible. Preserve every control and empty state, original photo appearance, source icon silhouettes/enclosures and compact whitespace. No extra text, decorative icons, duplicated controls, comparison grid, annotations or perspective. Crisp flat UI panel.
reviewNotes: 全体出力を目視し日本語全文・7上部アイコン・権限・担当・時刻表・説明・議論・フッターを確認。案内帯の淡い灰色、コメントの太字、シェブロン／ストップウォッチ細部に残差。白面と通常ウェイトへ訂正予定。以前の単体レビューを全体合格の根拠にしていない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
